_comment: Phase-4 E16: the overlay calling contract (ABI) for region A, verified statically across every LEVEL*.BIN. Regenerate: tools/phase4_e16_overlay_abi.c + the driver steps in EXP_2026-08-04_phase4_e16_chunk_roles.

region.header_word: the u32 at base+0 is a header, not code (LEVEL04/LEVEL1.BIN: 0x12); the first function begins at base+4

the_abi.shape: NOT a vector table. Resident code contains HARDCODED ABSOLUTE `jal` instructions into region A (e.g. `jal 0x800B39A4` at 0x8003D674/84/94/C4...), dispatched per scene. Each overlay implements only the entries ITS scene needs; the 42 addresses in the committed map are the UNION across the campaign, not a per-overlay requirement.
the_abi.verified: 19 LEVEL*.BIN files checked against all 42 addresses. Every overlay implements at least one entry (19/19); each implements 1-5; 17 distinct entry-sets across the 19 files.
the_abi.primary_entry: 0x800B39A4 (base+4) is the common entry: implemented by 13 of 19 overlays, which matches the committed map's record of 13 resident call sites for that address exactly.
the_abi.union_implemented: 27 of 42 addresses are implemented by some overlay in this file set (LOWER BOUND -- see method limits).

independent_corroborations: 13 implementing overlays vs 13 recorded resident call sites for 0x800B39A4 -- two unrelated counts agree
0x800B4084 is implemented by LEVEL08/LEVEL1.BIN, and committed C17 canon names 0x800B4084 the movie-viewer MENU READER -- the ABI scan independently places that function in the right overlay
region base 0x800B39A0 matches the base independently derived during D18 from the Bug Bar overlay's counter-store encoding
method_limits: A function start is detected as `addiu sp,sp,-N` or a bare `jr ra` stub. Leaf functions with other prologues are NOT recognised, so per-overlay entry counts and the 27/42 union are LOWER BOUNDS. This does not affect the shape of the ABI, only the completeness of the per-overlay entry lists.
mod_consequence: Because resident call sites are hardcoded absolute addresses into a swap buffer, an overlay-region address has no fixed meaning across scenes (the committed map already warns of this). A mod hooking region A must condition on the scene id 0x80082504, and must preserve the entry addresses its scene's overlay implements.

method_limits_TIGHTENED_2026-08-04.supersedes: A function start is detected as `addiu sp,sp,-N` or a bare `jr ra` stub. Leaf functions with other prologues are NOT recognised, so per-overlay entry counts and the 27/42 union are LOWER BOUNDS. This does not affect the shape of the ABI, only the completeness of the per-overlay entry lists.
method_limits_TIGHTENED_2026-08-04.what_changed: The 27/42 union and the per-overlay lists came from a detector that accepted only `addiu sp,sp,-N` or a bare `jr ra`, so leaf functions with other prologues read as 'not implemented'. A structurally different detector -- a function START is the instruction after the delay slot of a `jr ra` -- assumes no prologue at all.
method_limits_TIGHTENED_2026-08-04.result: prologue 27/42 (reproduced exactly, confirming the old method was replicated faithfully), return-derived 39/42, both 24, EITHER 42/42. Every one of the 42 committed region-A entry points is a function start in at least one overlay.
method_limits_TIGHTENED_2026-08-04.why_both_are_kept: They err in OPPOSITE directions -- prologue matching UNDER-counts, return scanning OVER-counts (data decoding as a false `jr ra` invents a start) -- so together they BRACKET the truth instead of replacing one guess with another. 3 entries are found ONLY by prologue matching, so the new detector does not subsume the old.
method_limits_TIGHTENED_2026-08-04.correction_overlay_count: This artifact says 19 LEVEL*.BIN. There are 20; LEVEL00's is a 4-byte stub (header word only, 0 functions), which is why it was invisible to a scan that counted implementing files.
